manifest.admission_identity: Complete exact existing R170v2 AdmissionIdentity projection: profile_id,grammar_domain,finance,layout_version,layout_digest,bounds_digest,field_id,program_membership_digest. Unselected remains tagged unselected; membership digest NOT ProgramImageId.
manifest.unknown_metrics: Concatenate each observations.unmeasured group metrics in same9group struct order, then io-bytes. Preserve multiplicity.

B.observations: Complete unchanged ResourceReport::from_owner v1 result on exact same HostObservation/RunSummary. CoreActionRun/DraftHostRun first call their existing observe and propagate existing ConsumerError; no new check or engine call.

write.io_bytes: same canonical decimal only AFTER writer.write_all(exactserializedbytes) succeeds; this is accepted Write-boundary bytes, not physical disk traffic/input/checkpoint I/O
write.errors: Serialization(serde_json::Error) or Io(std::io::Error); no success receipt on error. No new file/publisher/overwrite policy.

compatibility: Wv1 getters/serializers and R170historicalv2 getter/serializers preserved; all new APIs opt-in. Existing N01 supplied/live passes reused, no rerun. Program/layout/lowering/rule IDs are NOT synthesized from Debug/KDisplay/sourcehash.

newExpectedData: Independent new supplied N05 (calls/branch/depth) and N08 (fuelcut) + separate manually frozen error data; no evaluator/Machine invocation in source/expectation lanes. No acceptance closure.
